Semax is a lab-made peptide of 7 amino acids (Met-Glu-His-Phe-Pro-Gly-Pro): positions 4 to 7 of the hormone ACTH with a Pro-Gly-Pro tail added.12 Russia lists it among its vital and essential drugs and uses it for neurological conditions.3 It is not FDA-approved.4 Each vial holds 5 mg of freeze-dried (lyophilized) powder.5

Questions about Semax

  • What is Semax?

About Semax

Semax is a heptapeptide, a chain of 7 amino acids, designed as an analog of the ACTH(4-10) fragment of the hormone ACTH.16 Researchers at the Institute of Molecular Genetics of the Russian Academy of Sciences synthesize and study it, and Russian papers describe it as a drug used in stroke therapy.17 This listing offers it as a 5 mg research vial.

Its human research is Russian, and a 2026 review notes that this record lacks independent validation and systematic safety surveillance under Western regulatory frameworks.18 Read What is Semax? for the mechanism research, the full study list and side effects.

Research highlights

  • Rats (2006): a single dose raised hippocampal BDNF protein up to 1.4-fold and activation of its receptor, TrkB, 1.6-fold, and treated rats made more conditioned avoidance responses in a learning test.16
  • Rats (2006): labeled Semax reached the brain within 2 minutes of a nasal dose and was rapidly broken down, mostly to the tripeptide Pro-Gly-Pro.19
  • Stroke rehabilitation, 110 adults (2018): Semax raised blood BDNF regardless of when rehabilitation started, and Semax with high BDNF went with faster improvement; the abstract does not describe randomization.2021
  • Motor neuron disease, 27 adults (2007, open-label): no effect on nerve denervation measures or clinical scores, but a better overall quality-of-life score.1222
  • Healthy adults, 24 people (2018, placebo-controlled): 5 and 20 minutes after one nasal dose, the 14 given Semax showed a larger medial frontal part of the brain's default mode network on fMRI than the 10 given placebo.13
  • Rodents (2005): Semax alone left dopamine unchanged but strongly amplified the dopamine release caused by D-amphetamine.23

Regulatory status

Semax is not FDA-approved.4 FDA's page on compounding substances that may present significant safety risks lists Semax (heptapeptide) among category 2 nominations withdrawn by their nominators, citing possible immune reactions and limited safety information.249 On July 24, 2026, FDA's Pharmacy Compounding Advisory Committee discussed Semax for cerebral ischemia, migraine and trigeminal neuralgia.25 A law firm's summary of the meeting reports that the committee recommended adding Semax to the 503A bulks list.26 Such votes are non-binding, and FDA's meeting page showed no minutes or vote results when checked on October 25, 2026.2625 WADA's 2026 Prohibited List does not name Semax.28 A 2025 review rated its status unclear because of its similarity to tetracosactide, a banned S2 substance, while a 2026 review says WADA prohibits it.2729

Handling and storage

The supplier ships Semax as freeze-dried powder, without bacteriostatic water.58 GenScript does not recommend keeping peptides in solution; when it cannot be avoided, it suggests a pH 5 to 6 buffer, single-use aliquots at -20 °C and no repeated freeze-thaw cycles.7 The reconstitution guide covers the lab steps, and how to store peptides covers freezer and fridge storage.

Frequently asked questions

Can you get Semax over the counter?

Not as a US medicine.4 Semax is not FDA-approved, so no prescription or over-the-counter Semax drug exists in the US.4 In Russia it is on the national list of vital and essential drugs.3 This page lists Semax for sale only as a 5 mg research vial for laboratory work, and FDA lists Semax among compounding substances flagged for safety risks.9

What is the Semax price?

The Semax price starts at $35 for the 5 mg vial, and the stock status shows at the top of the page before checkout. Bacteriostatic water is not included and is sold separately.8 Research groups ordering in volume can apply through the wholesale program. Delivery details are on the shipping page, and return terms on the returns page.

How should Semax be stored when it arrives?

Freeze-dried peptides travel well at room temperature, according to Bachem, which recommends freezer storage for the long term and allows a 4 °C refrigerator for short-term use.10 Let a cold vial reach room temperature before opening it, because peptides pull water from the air.1011 GenScript lists glutamic acid and histidine, both found in Semax, among the amino acids that make peptides absorb moisture.71

Is there a certificate of analysis for Semax?

The lab results page explains what testing documentation the store provides. Check which tests a certificate reports, not only HPLC purity: FDA names aggregation and peptide-related impurities as the reasons compounded Semax may trigger immune reactions.9 Purity and content also differ, since Bachem notes that peptide powders may hold only 70 to 90% peptide by weight, the rest being counter-ions and water.11

What supplies are used with a Semax vial?

Bench work with a freeze-dried vial typically uses bacteriostatic water or another diluent, a 3 mL Luer-Lok syringe and alcohol swabs. The reconstitution calculator handles the concentration math. The Russian human studies that name the form used a ready-made 1% nasal solution, so they offer no mixing steps.1213

Is Semax for human use?

No. Every vial is labeled: For research use only. Not for human or veterinary use. Semax is not FDA-approved, and FDA says it has no, or only limited, safety information for the routes proposed for compounded Semax.49 A ClinicalTrials.gov search in October 2026 found no Semax study.14 In 2025, Health Canada named Semax among unauthorized injectable peptides it warned the public about.15
